label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: user cookie value flows through URL decoding, gets assigned to 'bar' (which is always the user input due to the guard (500/42)+num>200 being true), then is converted to a string and passed to encodeForHTML before being included in HTML output. The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled, making this a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: cookie value decoded and assigned to 'bar' based on always-true guard
user-controlled 'bar' value reaches HTML output via encodeForHTML
